query: I own 2 acres in Uttar Pradesh. Which central schemes may support me?
gold_answer: As a landholding farmer you may be eligible for PM-KISAN (Rs 6,000/year) plus crop insurance (PMFBY), Kisan Credit Card and Soil Health Card; confirm on the official site or at a CSC.

query: I lease farmland but do not own it. Can I qualify for PM-KISAN?
gold_answer: PM-KISAN is for farmer families whose name is in the land records; tenant/lease farmers usually cannot apply. Check with the state agriculture office.

query: I grow wheat and want crop insurance. What should I check?
gold_answer: PMFBY covers wheat (rabi) at a 1.5% farmer premium; check the notified crop/area for your district, the enrolment deadline, and enrol via bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in.

query: My crop was damaged by unseasonal rain. What PMFBY claim conditions apply?
gold_answer: Report the loss within 72 hours to the insurance company, bank or via the crop insurance app/helpline; localized calamities and post-harvest losses are assessed per field.

query: I am a dairy farmer. Is KCC available for animal husbandry?
gold_answer: Yes, Kisan Credit Card also covers working capital for animal husbandry (dairy) and fisheries at concessional interest.

query: I want irrigation support for a small farm in Uttar Pradesh. Which schemes may apply?
gold_answer: Per Drop More Crop gives 55% subsidy on drip/sprinkler irrigation for small and marginal farmers (45% for others).

query: Farmer in Bihar, 2 acres, age 30
gold_answer: You may be eligible for PM-KISAN, PM-KMY pension (age 18-40, small farmer), Kisan Credit Card, PMFBY and Per Drop More Crop.

query: Farmer in Punjab, 10 acres, age 45
gold_answer: PM-KISAN, KCC and PMFBY may suit you; PM-KMY pension is not available (only age 18-40 with up to 2 hectares).

query: I am a farmer aged 55 with 1 acre in Odisha
gold_answer: PM-KISAN, PMFBY and KCC may suit you; PM-KMY pension needs entry age 18-40.

query: I am 25, a farmer with 1.5 acres in Rajasthan. Is there any pension scheme for me?
gold_answer: PM-KMY: pay a small monthly contribution (about Rs 55-200) and get Rs 3,000/month pension after age 60; you fit the age 18-40 and land limits.

query: How do I apply for PM-KISAN?
gold_answer: Register on pmkisan.gov.in (New Farmer Registration) or at a CSC / state agriculture office with land records, Aadhaar and bank details; complete e-KYC.

query: What documents are needed for Kisan Credit Card?
gold_answer: Application form, identity and address proof, land records / cultivation proof, and a photo; apply at a bank.

query: I am a farmer. Is there a subsidy for buying a tractor?
gold_answer: SMAM gives 40-50% subsidy on farm machinery (50% for small/marginal, SC/ST and women farmers); apply on the state agri-machinery portal.

query: I am a farmer and want to grow vegetables in a polyhouse. Any help?
gold_answer: MIDH supports polyhouses/protected cultivation and horticulture with subsidy at state-set rates; apply through the state horticulture department.

query: I am a farmer. How can I get my soil tested for free?
gold_answer: Under the Soil Health Card scheme your soil is tested free and you get a card with fertiliser advice; contact the agriculture office or soil testing lab.

query: We are a women self help group in Maharashtra and want a drone for spraying.
gold_answer: Namo Drone Didi gives women SHGs 80% of drone cost (up to Rs 8 lakh) plus interest subvention on a loan for the rest.

query: I have a B.Sc Agriculture degree and want to start an agri clinic.
gold_answer: AC&ABC: free 45-day training, then a bank loan with 36% subsidy (44% for women/SC/ST/NE).

query: मैं बिहार का किसान हूँ, 1 एकड़ ज़मीन, उम्र 40
gold_answer: आप PM-KISAN, PM-KMY पेंशन (उम्र 18-40), KCC और फसल बीमा के लिए पात्र हो सकते हैं।

query: फसल बीमा के लिए आवेदन कैसे करें?
gold_answer: बैंक, CSC या pmfby.gov.in से कट-ऑफ तारीख से पहले नामांकन करें; ज़मीन और बुवाई का प्रमाण, आधार और बैंक विवरण रखें।

query: Compare income support, crop insurance and credit schemes for me. I am a farmer in Madhya Pradesh with 3 acres, age 35.
gold_answer: PM-KISAN = Rs 6,000/year income support; PMFBY = crop insurance at low premium; KCC = cheap crop loan. You may be eligible for all three.

query: The PM-KISAN guideline I found is dated 2020. Is it still current?
gold_answer: Rules change; check the latest guidelines and FAQs on pmkisan.gov.in or ask the state agriculture office.

query: Is PMFBY open in my district for the current kharif season?
gold_answer: Depends on your state's notification for the season; check pmfby.gov.in, your bank or CSC for notified crops, areas and the deadline.

query: I am a B.Tech student with family income of ₹3 lakh. Which scholarships may apply?
gold_answer: AICTE Pragati (if you are a girl), Saksham (if specially-abled) and the Central Sector Scholarship (if top 20 percentile in class 12) may apply.

query: I am a girl studying a technical diploma. What AICTE support may be relevant?
gold_answer: AICTE Pragati gives girl students in AICTE-approved degree/diploma courses Rs 50,000/year if family income is up to Rs 8 lakh.

query: I am a specially-abled student pursuing a technical degree, family income 4 lakh.
gold_answer: AICTE Saksham (Rs 50,000/year) and the DEPwD disability scholarships may suit you.

query: I belong to the SC category and got admission in IIT Delhi. Family income 5 lakh.
gold_answer: Top Class Education for SC students covers full fees, living costs, books and a laptop at notified institutions like IITs (income up to Rs 8 lakh).

query: I am a student in a state university. Can I apply through the National Scholarship Portal?
gold_answer: Yes, many central scholarships are applied for on scholarships.gov.in if your institution is registered there.

query: OBC student in BA, family income 2 lakh, Uttar Pradesh
gold_answer: PM-YASASVI post-matric scholarship for OBC students (income up to Rs 2.5 lakh) may suit you.

query: ST student doing B.Com, family income 1.8 lakh, from Jharkhand
gold_answer: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST students (income up to Rs 2.5 lakh) pays fees and maintenance.

query: I am a student in class 8, family income 2 lakh. Any scholarship?
gold_answer: NMMSS: pass the state NMMS exam in class 8 and get Rs 12,000/year in classes 9-12 (income up to Rs 3.5 lakh).

query: I was in the top 1% in my class 12 board and joined B.Sc Physics.
gold_answer: INSPIRE-SHE gives Rs 80,000/year for B.Sc/M.Sc in natural sciences to top 1% class 12 students.

query: I am a student from Assam doing BA, family income 3 lakh
gold_answer: Ishan Uday scholarship for North-East students (income up to Rs 4.5 lakh) may suit you.

query: I am a student from Bihar doing BA, family income 3 lakh
gold_answer: Ishan Uday is only for North-East states; check category-based post-matric scholarships.

query: I lost both my parents and study an engineering diploma. Family income 1 lakh.
gold_answer: AICTE Swanath scholarship for orphans and wards of martyrs gives Rs 50,000/year in AICTE-approved courses.

query: What documents do I need for AICTE Pragati?
gold_answer: Income certificate, admission proof, class 10/12 marksheets, Aadhaar-linked bank account, and institute verification on NSP.

query: How do I apply for PM YASASVI?
gold_answer: Apply on the National Scholarship Portal or your state scholarship portal with caste and income certificates.

query: Girl student, B.Tech, OBC, family income 2 lakh, Delhi
gold_answer: AICTE Pragati and PM-YASASVI may both suit you.

query: मैं बी.टेक की छात्रा हूँ, परिवार की आय 3 लाख
gold_answer: AICTE Pragati छात्रवृत्ति (Rs 50,000/वर्ष) के लिए आप पात्र हो सकती हैं।

query: मैं अनुसूचित जाति का छात्र हूँ, आईआईटी में दाखिला मिला है, आय 6 लाख
gold_answer: Top Class Education (SC) योजना पूरी फीस और रहने का खर्च देती है।

query: I am a B.Tech girl and my family income is 9 lakh
gold_answer: AICTE Pragati needs income up to Rs 8 lakh, so it does not apply; other merit-based schemes may.

query: What is the deadline to apply for NMMSS this year?
gold_answer: Dates change every year; check scholarships.gov.in and the state NMMS exam notification.

query: I am a disabled student in class 11, family income 2 lakh
gold_answer: DEPwD post-matric scholarship for students with disabilities may suit you (Saksham is only for AICTE technical courses).

query: I want to start a new small manufacturing unit in Uttar Pradesh. I am 35.
gold_answer: PMEGP (15-35% subsidy on the bank loan), CGTMSE (collateral-free loan) and UP MSME schemes may help.

query: I am 19 and want to start a service business. Can PMEGP be relevant?
gold_answer: Yes, PMEGP is open to anyone above 18 for new units; service projects up to Rs 20 lakh.

query: I am a woman entrepreneur in Karnataka seeking a business loan, age 30.
gold_answer: PMEGP (higher subsidy for women) and CGTMSE collateral-free loans may suit you.

query: Does CGTMSE give the loan directly to an entrepreneur?
gold_answer: No. Banks/lenders give the loan; CGTMSE guarantees it so you need no collateral.

query: I run an existing micro enterprise. Can I apply for PMEGP?
gold_answer: PMEGP is for new units; existing PMEGP units with a good record can get a second loan for upgrading.

query: What documents are required for a PMEGP application?
gold_answer: Project report, identity and address proof, education/caste certificates if relevant; apply on the KVIC PMEGP portal.

query: I want to set up a pickle making unit at home in Bihar. I am 32.
gold_answer: PMFME gives 35% credit-linked subsidy (up to Rs 10 lakh) for micro food processing; PMEGP also applies.

query: I have a DPIIT-recognised startup and need seed funding
gold_answer: Startup India Seed Fund: up to Rs 20 lakh grant for prototype and up to Rs 50 lakh for market entry, via approved incubators.

query: I am 30 and want to open a bakery in Pune, Maharashtra
gold_answer: CMEGP Maharashtra (15-35% subsidy), PMFME (food processing) and PMEGP may suit you.

query: I am 55 and want to start a business in Maharashtra
gold_answer: PMEGP and CGTMSE may suit you; CMEGP has an upper age limit of 45-50.

query: I am a carpenter in Lucknow and want toolkit and training support for my work
gold_answer: UP Vishwakarma Shram Samman Yojana gives traditional artisans free training and a toolkit.

query: I want to start a business. What is the difference between a loan, credit guarantee and subsidy?
gold_answer: Loan = money from a bank you repay; credit guarantee (CGTMSE) = backing so you need no collateral; subsidy (PMEGP) = part of the loan the government pays.

query: Does PMEGP cover working capital or only project costs?
gold_answer: PMEGP covers capital expenditure plus one cycle of working capital in the project cost.

query: The CGTMSE guideline I have is old. How do I verify the latest terms?
gold_answer: Check cgtmse.in for the latest scheme document and circulars, or ask your bank.

query: मैं उत्तर प्रदेश में नया व्यवसाय शुरू करना चाहता हूँ, उम्र 28
gold_answer: PMEGP, CGTMSE और UP MSME / विश्वकर्मा योजना आपके लिए हो सकती हैं।

query: How much subsidy does PMFME give?
gold_answer: 35% of project cost as credit-linked subsidy, up to Rs 10 lakh per unit.

query: I am an entrepreneur in an artisan group wanting to develop a traditional industry cluster. Is SFURTI relevant?
gold_answer: SFURTI is not in our catalogue; check myscheme.gov.in or the KVIC/MSME office. PMEGP may help individual members.

gold_answer: Asks which scheme you mean, with one button per scheme shown.

query: I am a farmer in Uttar Pradesh with 2 acres, age 35. Find schemes for me and tell me the documents for the best one.
gold_answer: Shows farmer scheme cards, then lists the documents for the top scheme (PM-KISAN: Aadhaar, land records, Aadhaar-linked bank account).

query: B.Tech girl student, OBC, family income 3 lakh. Which scholarships can I get, and how do I apply for the best one?
gold_answer: Shows scholarship cards (incl. AICTE Pragati), then gives application steps for the top scholarship only.

query: I want to start a food processing unit in Bihar. Show my schemes and explain how to apply for the most suitable one.
gold_answer: Shows business scheme cards with PMFME first, then explains how to apply for PMFME.

query: How can I complete e-KYC for PM-KISAN?
gold_answer: Three ways: OTP-based e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal/app, biometric e-KYC at a CSC or State Seva Kendra, or face authentication on the PM-KISAN mobile app.

query: What is the collateral-free limit on a Kisan Credit Card?
gold_answer: Collateral-free credit up to Rs 2 lakh per borrower; the KCC loan limit under the interest subvention scheme is Rs 5 lakh.

query: How are soil samples collected for the Soil Health Card?
gold_answer: Samples are taken at 15-20 cm depth with a V-shaped cut from four corners and the centre of the field, in a grid of 2.5 ha (irrigated) or 10 ha (rain-fed).

query: What marks do I need to keep getting the INSPIRE SHE scholarship?
gold_answer: Pass all subjects in the first attempt with at least 60% marks (or 7.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale) for the scholarship to continue.

query: I am a woman starting a small unit. How much guarantee cover does CGTMSE give on my loan?
gold_answer: For women-led enterprises CGTMSE covers 90% of the loan (raised from 85% in December 2024); the bank decides on the loan.

query: What is the maximum loan amount that can be covered under CGTMSE?
gold_answer: Guarantee cover is available for loans up to Rs 10 crore (ceiling raised from Rs 5 crore from April 2025).

query: Do I need to do any training to get a PMEGP loan?
gold_answer: Yes: beneficiaries must complete Entrepreneurship Development Programme (EDP) training before the loan/margin money is released.
